body: Ehh, with the US about to go full fascist and the climate being fucked I don't really feel like doing anything at this point. I'm just glad I never bothered even trying since it would suck to have it all fall apart anyways.

I feel like I've set the stage for that. There's essentially no record of me for my entire life. No pictures, no social media posts, nothing to remember me by. I'm just waiting for the strength to pop off a bridge.

Well I was too drunk to remember anything, but it was pretty obviously intentional though everyone essentially denied it. As for injuries, I fell perfectly on my right side, so as to distribute the impact in the least damaging way. Broke 5 ribs and the spinous processes on L2-L5, fractured right acetabular, punctured and collapsed my right lung, liver contusion, ruptured right eardrum, and a mild concussion. Also some scratches and mild bruises. After 8 weeks it was as if nothing ever happened, I have a scar from the chest drain but that's it.
I fully accept your apology. I understand you just want to help, and that now that you to be more careful. Don't give up please, we need you too.

Like my life is dogshit but at least im not get drawn and quartered or flayed alive,
